name: Aundre Johnson
office: City of Claremont, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Aundré Johnson is a film and television director and consultant. He previously ran a video production business and worked at 20th Century Fox Television. His campaign says he served as a volunteer on the Claremont Police Commission, the Police Station Citizens Advisory Committee, and the Sumner Danbury Elementary School Site Council.

items.text: His campaign says if elected he would focus on neighborhood safety, infrastructure, and homelessness. He also supports responsible spending and government transparency.
